# SLIP-0010 vectors

`slip10_vectors.json` transcribes every displayed node from the four-curve
vectors and both NIST P-256 retry vectors in
[`slip-0010.md` at commit `0c9ce4e7cc53371e4d132563c1d4e1ce7351e707`](https://github.com/satoshilabs/slips/blob/0c9ce4e7cc53371e4d132563c1d4e1ce7351e707/slip-0010.md).

The test loader asserts that the fixture contains exactly 52 nodes.
